listings.Job Description: Internship in Quantitative Research/Trading involving roles as Quantitative Researcher and Quantitative Trader, utilizing mathematical modeling, statistical techniques, and data analysis to develop investment strategies and improve trading platform performance.
listings.Job Requirements: Candidates must be penultimate or final year students pursuing a Bachelor's, Master's, or PhD in a quantitative field. Skills required include high technical knowledge in statistics, machine learning, coding in Python or C++, ability to work autonomously and collaboratively, strong communication skills, and fluency in English.
